question: Can the same-full-action elliptic completion be reduced on flat FLRW to a closed linear scalar metric system suitable for CLASS, after eliminating A, Newtonian prepotential, Q and Lambda without replacing the theory by an effective-fluid sound-speed patch?

primary_convention_reference.paper: T. Zhu, F.-W. Shu, Q. Wu, A. Wang, General covariant Horava-Lifshitz gravity without projectability condition and its applications to cosmology
primary_convention_reference.scope: nonprojectable local-U(1) scalar-constraint and flat-FLRW perturbation conventions only; coefficients of the RTK completion must still be derived from the frozen same-action ansatz

mandatory_derivation: derive the A and prepotential source normalizations directly from the frozen completion action and match them to the primary-source J_A and J_varphi definitions before substituting any formula
write the full scalar auxiliary/metric linear system on flat FLRW in one gauge with an explicit Fourier convention
eliminate Q and Lambda together with A and the Newtonian prepotential; do not solve one constraint while silently dropping another
derive the reduced Hamiltonian, momentum, trace and traceless metric equations or an algebraically equivalent closed first-order system
compute the auxiliary constraint determinant/rank and exclude isolated roots over the declared q and EFT-history domain
show the k->0 and completion-off/near-deformation limits explicitly
identify the exact mapping to CLASS perturbation variables and required new state/algebraic variables before editing the production likelihood path
fail_closed_conditions: source normalization cannot be matched to action variation
constraint matrix loses rank inside the declared production domain
the reduction requires interpreting RTK fitted Om as physical CDM or total matter
a phenomenological c_s^2 substitution is used instead of solving the U1 constraints
the reduced system does not recover its frozen control limit
non_claims: The cited nonprojectable U1 paper is a convention/reference basis, not proof that its action equals the RTK completion.
Passing this gate does not establish the completed-action likelihood fit.
Passing this gate does not establish nonlinear or compact-object viability.
Massive-neutrino anisotropic-stress extension is a later explicit gate.
next_if_pass: Implement the reduced system in a shadow CLASS integration with completion-off and near-deformation controls before any production likelihood evaluation.
